reason: The hypothesis applies the well-known concept of homogenization to a specific, previously unstudied additively manufactured HEA composition (Al0.2Co1.5CrFeNi1.5Ti0.3) and links as-built microsegregation and porosity directly to a proposed mechanism of non-uniform diffusion, localized stress accumulation, and catastrophic failure during high-temperature gas exposure. While homogenization and its general benefits are textbook knowledge, the specific mechanistic chain connecting AM defects to catastrophic oxidation failure in this alloy is not stated in any passage.
